scope: PocketWorld interaction adapters, reviewed source snapshots; no new native authority

references.name: BeUI Morphing Search
adaptation: Retain actual controlled filtering, combobox, IME, keyboard and host onSelect actions.
Adapt original shared active-result layout, .58/.22 morph and .32 clip transition in the existing navigation drawer. Do not create another modal, portal, scroll lock or focus trap.
Never retain outgoing actionable search rows.

references.name: BeUI Morphing Modal
adaptation: Port original layout panel + layout-position inner content with SPRING_PANEL into existing review shells.
Host drawer/dialog retains focus trapping and back handling. Only current approval buttons exist; pending disables both actions and errors remain visible.

references.name: BeUI Sortable List
adaptation: Actual source retained including drag handles, keyboard Home/End/arrow movement, stable IDs, reorder validation and undo.
Localize strings, replace icon imports, use local retained easing/utilities, neutral CSS.
Only current page directory display order changes, with explicit user-facing scope. No execution priority or saved order is claimed.

references.name: BeUI Swipeable List
references.productUsage: ReviewCenter task-directory row: reveal 查看详情; calls the same existing onSelect(id)
adaptation: Actual source retains swipe thresholds, release spring, keyboard disclosure/focus, inert hidden rails and one controlled open row.
No swipe-to-approve, delete, dismiss or state change. Hidden and outgoing task authority is not recreated.
Localize labels, replace icon imports and restyle grayscale.
Suppress the pointer click following a completed row drag so embedded real selection buttons do not also activate. Keyboard activation remains available.

references.name: ncdai React Wheel Picker
references.productUsage: ReminderWorkspace calendar local-time draft via WheelTimeField
adaptation: Vendor actual geometry, pointer/wheel inertia, typeahead and grouped keyboard focus source.
Add labelled spinbutton semantics and hide duplicate visual lists from accessibility tree.
Add disabled/inert handling, abort gestures and rAF, restore visual selection when disabled, and guard current callbacks.
Reduced-motion or hidden-document animation snaps to endScroll and completes exactly once; fix original duration-zero branch that snapped to startScroll.
Latest-time ref merges concurrent hour/minute updates. Preserve exact HH:mm TextField, invalid partial input, and original native preview/confirm flow. No wheel action submits.

references.name: BoardUI Slider + Ramotion Fluid Slider reference
references.productUsage: Controlled draft-value companion for existing exact numeric input; host wires budget/limits.
adaptation: Actual BoardUI Slider render model and React Aria primitives retain hidden range input, value precision, bounds, step, keyboard and disabled semantics.

Ramotion ValueView tracking elevation and .22s return are bounded Web styling/animation guidance. This is not an official Web port or a claim that the original UIKit/CoreImage metaball filter runs in Web.
Current exact value remains visible; out-of-range or non-finite host values disable the slider without coercing the draft.
Neutral color, inherit user font, reduced-motion zero duration.
references.credit: Fluid Slider visual reference: Ramotion https://www.ramotion.com/; original design inspiration Virgil Pana https://dribbble.com/shots/3868232-Fluid-Slider
